observation_contract.note: Fixture definitions contain expectations and review rubrics only. Quality, context, harvested-slice bindings, and evaluator provenance must come from observed benchmark runs.

fixtures.objective: Discover product needs, establish UI structure, implement the surface, and verify rendered accessibility.

dimensions.criterion: The outcome traces product and user decisions to explicit needs.
The implemented surface preserves the intended hierarchy and interaction behavior.
Rendered accessibility, responsive behavior, and reduced motion are verified.
The final artifact states residual gaps and the evidence supporting completion.

skill_sources.content:
---
name: product-discovery
---
Elicit explicit user needs, product states, and decision criteria before design.
Inputs: product objective.
Outputs: product needs handoff.
Exit gate: decision criteria.

---
name: pixel-lock
---
Freeze visual details before discovery; this intentionally conflicts with discovery in the same stage.

---
name: ui-architecture
---
Translate product needs into reusable hierarchy, states, components, and interaction structure.
Inputs: product needs handoff.
Outputs: component handoff.
Exit gate: interaction structure.

---
name: frontend-implementation
---
Implement the approved interface structure with shared components and bounded interactions.
Inputs: component handoff.
Outputs: rendered behavior handoff.
Exit gate: bounded interactions.

---
name: accessibility-verification
---
Verify rendered keyboard, contrast, responsive, and reduced-motion behavior with evidence.
Inputs: rendered behavior handoff.
Outputs: accessibility verification handoff.
Exit gate: accessibility evidence.

fixtures.objective: Assess migration readiness, verify data integrity, prove rollback, and execute the regression strategy.

dimensions.criterion: The migration identifies and tests the material data invariants.
Rollback triggers, procedure, and recovery evidence are concrete and executable.
Focused tests cover partial, repeated, failed, and successful migration paths.
The final recommendation connects evidence to a bounded cutover decision.

skill_sources.content:
---
name: migration-readiness
---
Inventory migration dependencies, cutover gates, rollback triggers, and unresolved readiness risks.
Inputs: migration objective.
Outputs: migration readiness handoff.
Exit gate: readiness risks.

---
name: unreviewed-cutover
---
Perform a cutover before readiness review; this intentionally conflicts with readiness in one stage.

---
name: data-integrity-audit
---
Define data invariants and verify identity, ordering, parity, and referential integrity.
Inputs: migration readiness handoff.
Outputs: data integrity handoff.
Exit gate: integrity verification.

---
name: rollback-verification
---
Prove rollback procedures, recovery checkpoints, and restored data integrity with evidence.
Inputs: data integrity handoff.
Outputs: rollback handoff.
Exit gate: recovery checkpoints.

---
name: test-strategy
---
Cover successful, partial, repeated, interrupted, and failed migration behavior with focused tests.
Inputs: rollback handoff.
Outputs: regression handoff.
Exit gate: verify migration behavior.

fixtures.objective: Design the agent workflow, define routing, audit safety boundaries, and verify receipts before promotion.

dimensions.criterion: Stages, handoffs, entry gates, and exit gates form an executable workflow.
Routing activates the required capabilities without unrelated or conflicting skills.
External effects, sensitive data, and instruction precedence remain explicitly bounded.
Receipts and promotion eligibility are reviewable and never imply automatic learning.

skill_sources.content:
---
name: workflow-design
---
Define executable workflow stages, inputs, outputs, handoffs, entry gates, and exit gates.
Inputs: workflow objective.
Outputs: routing handoff.
Exit gate: exit gates.

---
name: routing-policy
---
Map task and evidence signals to deterministic capability routes and deferral conditions.
Inputs: routing handoff.
Outputs: security handoff.
Exit gate: deferral conditions.

---
name: security-privacy-audit
---
Audit sensitive data, permissions, instruction precedence, and external side-effect boundaries.
Inputs: security handoff.
Outputs: security handoff.
Exit gate: side-effect boundaries.

---
name: unreviewed-auto-promotion
---
Promote workflow state without receipts; this intentionally conflicts with verified promotion.

---
name: receipt-verification
---
Verify structured outcomes, gates, provenance, lift, and explicit promotion eligibility.
Inputs: security handoff.
Outputs: receipt handoff.
Exit gate: promotion eligibility.

fixtures.objective: Research sources, write the domain artifact, review the draft, and verify all citations.

dimensions.criterion: Material claims are grounded in authoritative, relevant sources.
The artifact converts evidence into accurate domain reasoning and decisions.
Structure, clarity, and audience fit survive an explicit editorial review.
Every material citation resolves and supports the associated claim.

skill_sources.content:
---
name: source-research
---
Gather authoritative sources and map each material claim to explicit supporting evidence.
Inputs: research objective.
Outputs: evidence handoff.
Exit gate: authoritative sources.

---
name: draft-before-sources
---
Draft claims before research; this intentionally conflicts with source-first work in one stage.

---
name: domain-writing
---
Synthesize verified evidence into an accurate, audience-specific domain artifact.
Inputs: evidence handoff.
Outputs: artifact handoff.
Exit gate: accurate domain artifact.

---
name: editorial-review
---
Review structure, clarity, claim precision, and audience fit, then require a revised artifact.
Inputs: artifact handoff.
Outputs: claim handoff.
Exit gate: revised artifact.

---
name: citation-verification
---
Resolve each citation and verify that it directly supports the associated material claim.
Inputs: claim handoff.
Outputs: citation handoff.
Exit gate: citation verification.

fixtures.objective: Diagnose the failure, implement the narrow fix, protect it with regression coverage, and verify release behavior.

dimensions.criterion: The diagnosis explains the observed failure with reproducible evidence.
The implementation fixes the cause with bounded collateral change.
Behavioral coverage fails before the fix and passes after it where reproducible.
The relevant release or installed behavior is verified and residual risk is explicit.

skill_sources.content:
---
name: root-cause-analysis
---
Reproduce the failure, distinguish symptoms from causes, and cite evidence for the diagnosis.
Inputs: failure objective.
Outputs: root cause handoff.
Exit gate: diagnosis evidence.

---
name: quick-patch
---
Patch the symptom before diagnosis; this intentionally conflicts with root-cause work in one stage.

---
name: targeted-fix
---
Implement the narrowest change that resolves the evidenced root cause and limits collateral effects.
Inputs: root cause handoff.
Outputs: fix handoff.
Exit gate: narrowest change.

---
name: regression-testing
---
Protect confirmed behavior with focused regression coverage and before-and-after evidence.
Inputs: fix handoff.
Outputs: behavior handoff.
Exit gate: regression coverage.

---
name: release-verification
---
Verify installed or release behavior, disclose residual risks, and retain completion evidence.
Inputs: behavior handoff.
Outputs: release handoff.
Exit gate: release verification.
